title: Compared Kummer Ext class as the actual single boundary
statement: Let ell be prime and invertible on a scheme W and fix n>=0, with the canonical Ext structure and chosen derived category of integral pro-etale sheaves [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext]. The hom of kappa_n [def-sfb-kummer-strict-adjunct-data] is single(cartierUnitsComparison) followed by the single connecting boundary of the actual short exact Kummer complex [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data], followed by single(cartierProRootMap)[1].

source.place: Step (4), the positive Kummer connecting class preceded by comparison on units.

proof.text: Expand the definitions of the compared Kummer class and its two degree-zero endpoint factors. Ext.comp_hom, Ext.mk0_hom and the two shifted-Hom composition formulas turn these into composition of the corresponding single maps. The extClass_hom theorem identifies the remaining hom with the actual short-exact-sequence boundary. The typed intermediate Ext class keeps the actual kernel and units sheaves fixed throughout.

lean.statement:
theorem kummer_compared_boundary_formula (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)] (n : ℕ) :
    let F := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0
    let hS := cartierProKummer_exact W (ℓ ^ (n + 1))
      (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _) (by simpa using hW.pow (n + 1))
    let δ : F.obj (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf W) ⟶
        (F.obj (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf W (ℓ ^ (n + 1))))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ := hS.singleδ
    (kummerComparedUnit ℓ W hW n).hom = F.map (cartierUnitsComparison W) ≫ δ ≫
      (F.map (cartierProRootMap (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ℓ ^ (n + 1))
        (cartierResidue_cast ℓ (n + 1)) W (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _)
        (by simpa using hW.pow (n + 1))))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
